fusions.name: Closing Drill
fusions.desc: A lunging kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times that from the full distance. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%. Holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Form Breaker
fusions.desc: A spinning kick at a target at or below 25% health that deals 22 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Kata of the Road
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds and your movement speed by 20% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Steps
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, your next strike within 5 seconds gains 12% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
